label: YouTube Channel Scraper
title: YouTube Channel Scraper: Channels, Videos & Transcripts
metaDescription: Find YouTube channels by keyword with subscribers, views, country and contact links, or scrape videos, Shorts, live streams and playlists with transcripts.
intro: Search YouTube channels by keyword and get subscribers, total views, country, join date and public contact links, or scrape a channel's videos, Shorts, live streams, podcasts, courses and playlists with full metadata and optional transcripts (text, SRT or WebVTT).
useCases: Find creators for influencer outreach by topic and audience size
Export a channel's full video list with views and dates
Pull transcripts of a channel's videos for summaries or search

faq.q: How do I find YouTube channels by keyword with subscriber counts?
faq.a: Enter one or more keywords and choose channels as the result type. Each channel comes with subscribers, video count, total views, country and join date, as in the sample above.
Yes. When you scrape videos, switch transcripts on and pick text, SRT or WebVTT.

officialApi: The YouTube Data API v3 is free but metered: 10,000 quota units a day by default, and one search call costs 100 units, so about 100 searches a day. This scraper has no daily quota; you pay per channel profile or video returned.
